# 4 bed townhouse for sale

> Grimes are delighted to introduce ‘Carriglea', No. 2 Harbour Road, Skerries, a remarkable four-bedroom period townhouse enjoying a truly exceptional coastal setting. Dating from circa 1890, this substantial home presents an exciting opportunity to restore and modernise a property of genuine character, with the rare benefit of direct access from the rear garden onto North Beach.

## Fakta
- Typ: townhouse
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 146 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Carriglea, 2 Harbour Road, Skerries
- Cena: 780 000 €
